issues.quote: Review 30 days after launch, requesting rooftop first; if median wait does not fall, rollout stops.
issues.concern: The go or no-go runs first at the one store where you cannot see the replies. That used car manager's people work out of two VinSolutions tabs, CRM activity is read nowhere yet, and a click does not stop the clock. So at that rooftop the median wait counts only console replies. It can fail to fall while the floor is answering customers, or fall for reasons that have nothing to do with the queue. You would stop the rollout, or push it out, on a number that is blind at the pilot store.
issues.because: E10, E13; Q15, Q18; v3 line "pre-UI baseline misses CRM-sent replies"
issues.ask: Say the stop rule uses median wait only where replies are visible (CRM activity read, or reps who reply from the console). Anywhere else, judge on click-clear share and what the manager says about his day. Or run the first review at a rooftop where reps reply from the console. The PRD can carry the detail, but the one-pager should not promise a stop decision on a number the pilot store cannot produce.
